name: JW Library
dev: Watchtower Bible and Tract Society of New York, Inc.

ios.desc:
The JW Library app* is designed to enhance your Bible reading and deepen your personal study. Download Bible-based publications, videos, and audio programs to access your content anytime, anywhere.

Multiple Bible Translations
• Read God’s Word and compare verses from various Bible translations available in hundreds of languages.

Library of Publications
• Download books, brochures, and articles in over 1,000 languages, including more than 100 sign languages.

Videos and Audio Programs
• Enjoy a variety of programs, including videos on Bible teachings, Bible talks, feature dramas, and animated series.

Music
• Listen to a variety of original compositions, including vocal, orchestral, and instrumental recordings.

Daily Text
• Start your day with a Bible verse and comments containing positive, upbuilding thoughts.

Meetings
• Access material for both midweek and weekend meetings in one location.

Search
• Find specific Bible verses, content, and topics.

Personal Study
• Highlight text, add personal notes, and categorize with tags.

Playlists
• Create and organize playlists of music, videos, audio programs, and pictures.

* JW Library is an official app produced by Jehovah’s Witnesses.
